main_text.head: ERRATA
main_text.p: Eminentiora Lector haud gravatè fic emendabit.
Pag. 337. lin. 34. scribe, in hac mortalitate.
Pag. 387. linea 34. sic emenda: statim baptizati fuerunt: ideo & eucharistia tantum datur baptizatis. Hi enim sVel dele vocabulum eucharistia.

page.notes: The last line of the errata paragraph is cut off at the right edge of the text block ("Hi enim s-" continues the word "sunt" or similar, which is not visible); the words "Hi enim s" are printed as far as legible. The word "ideo" ends with a printed mark at the margin. Stains and show-through from the other side are not transcribed.
